item.title: A research agenda for integrating artificial intelligence in mitigation scenario workflows
item.content:encoded:
Nature Climate Change, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02801-y

The integration of artificial intelligence into mitigation scenarios development could reduce the current bottlenecks. This Perspective proposes a research agenda to address these challenges at each phase, highlighting the importance of both agentic architecture and expert oversight.

item.title: Adapting minds to live with climate change
item.content:encoded:
Nature Climate Change, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02804-9

Climate adaptation psychology is fragmented across psychology’s subfields and neighbouring social sciences. This Perspective consolidates the scattered research into a four-layer framework (exposures, mediators, responses and outcomes) and closes with clinical implications and a research agenda.
item.dc:title: Adapting minds to live with climate change
